scope: Strict40 trainCAD x ver/hor/tor (120),5 validationCAD x ver/hor/tor (15); no dia/final5 or stress optimizer labels

API.summary: best_metrics/final_metrics groups train/validation with u metrics and strain {per_case,case_mean_relative_l2,worst_case_relative_l2}; strain per_case.relative_l2 is all-node recovered symmetric Frobenius
API.resume: --resume OUTPUT/last.pt; model/optimizer/fixed scaler/relative-case weights/history best and three sampling RNG streams saved; strict identical contract

sampling.historical_change: Both branches use mixed uniform-node/tet-corner sampling rather than historical pure-uniform nodes
sampling.first_batch_witness: Ordered case indices, all uniform node IDs, sampled cell IDs and ordered four-corner IDs; separate case/node/tet RNGs

objective.u_loss: relative_case_mse on all12800 mixed queries; unchanged train-only common zero-center RMS decode
objective.strain_loss: mean sampled cells (V/fixed full-case mean V)*FrobeniusErrorSquared/train-case full-volume-weighted reference squared RMS
objective.physical_corner_u_and_P1: FP64, signed u physical mm, tensor shear; one ordinary first-order parameter gradient
objective.zero_branch: Same strain arithmetic on detached corner predictions; auxiliary term contributes no parameter gradient
objective.GT_supervision: Reference P1 only from aligned known-load train displacement; no reference tensor is a model input

evaluation.selection: Known-load validation mean all-node physical u relativeL2 ONLY
evaluation.strain: Reuse same full u predictions; corner-P1 recovered to all10 original nodes by incident positive-volume averaging
evaluation.native_basis_reuse: Nine basis components evaluated once per CAD, composed for ver/hor/tor unit coefficients

cache.preparation_executed_by: hashgrid_impl under parent authorization; trainer acceptance did not run GPU

checks.first_decoder_gradient_guard: passed CPU present/finite/nonzero and rejected missing/nonfinite/zero
checks.native_first_backward: Formal parent runs check encoder/context plus all decoder gradients present and finite; decoder_gradient_l1>0 recorded before first optimizer step

scientific_limit: P1 proxy diagnostic and derivative supervision, not original solver strain/stress or a generalization claim; FP64 geometry cannot recover FP16 native decoder precision
